ios.desc:
Count anything. Anytime.
Clicker Counter is a simple, fast, and clean app that helps you track whatever matters — habits, people, prayers, scores, or tasks.

The app includes ready-made templates to get started quickly, and lets you create your own custom counters with just a few taps. You can also organize your counters by category to keep everything neat and easy to find.

Supports both light and dark mode for a smooth experience day or night.

No clutter. No distractions. Just tap and count.
